paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges the submission deadline of September 15, 2023, by 4pm, as specified in the RFP. The proposer has ensured that all necessary inputs will be provided to the bid manager by September 8, 2023, to facilitate timely submission of the proposal.

All inquiries and communications regarding this proposal have been and will continue to be conducted exclusively through the designated email address, bids@syrairport.org, in compliance with the RFP requirements.

The proposer confirms its willingness and ability to provide additional information or clarifications as requested by the customer. The engineering lead is available for interviews to address any technical or project-specific queries.
